query:
The group has an unspoken norm of keeping the chat focused on reunion planning and alumni news, with personal life updates handled in smaller threads or DMs. Does this genuinely apply to all members? If not, who treats this differently and what does their behaviour show?

Options:
A. Jade and Temi
B. Omar and Dev
C. Sana and Rachel
D. Callum and Lena
context:
[1] (about=Temi, episodic, t16 @2026-10-19T20:07:00) since we're here, I want to actually write about what makes this group work. not in a saccharine way. I mean the tensions, the sub-cliques, the person who almost never shows up until they do. what's your read on whether people would be okay with that
[2] (about=Jade, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T20:46:00) in!! also I've been properly thinking about this group this year. like how did we end up actually close when for years this chat was basically just 'anyone fancy a pub in January'. what's the story of how this actually became a real thing
[3] (about=Temi, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T20:47:00) Jade. this is exactly what my series is about. okay so I've been thinking about this for months. the chat existed for three years as a logistics thread. it became something else when Lena came back and showed up to that pub night properly for the first time. that was the turning point.
[4] (about=Temi, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:20:00) Lena yes. and I noticed you and Jade and Sana basically had a whole separate thread going between the gallery and the restaurant. the three of you seemed like you'd been talking for years.
[5] (about=Temi, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T20:53:00) Dev has a point actually. the group that can fall out and come back is not the same as one that just never tests the relationship. what's your read on whether that applies to other pairs in here
[6] (about=Jade, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:21:00) okay but real talk, that conversation was one of the best I've had all year. Sana and Lena are both back and I've somehow barely seen either of them one-on-one. that needs to change!! 😄
[7] (about=Jade, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:39:00) okay but real talk, Callum thank you for saying that. genuinely. this is what the group is for!! 💙
[8] (about=Temi, episodic, t15 @2026-10-19T20:00:00) okay so I've been thinking about this and I need to share something. the piece went up today. my features editor loved it and has asked me to develop it into a longer series on alumni communities. she said it might be the best thing I've written this year. I'm actually quite proud of it.
[9] (about=Jade, episodic, t4 @2026-01-19T20:16:00) Lena!! I noticed you actually seemed to enjoy yourself, not just tolerate it 😄 you and Sana were in a whole separate conversation the whole second half
[10] (about=Sana, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:22:00) all well. good evening. I'd forgotten what it felt like to just sit and talk without it being about logistics.
[11] (about=Callum, core, t8 @2026-02-02T19:56:00) Callum confirms he is in for the reunion dinner on 21 March, will skip the optional gallery and arrive for dinner due to kids on a Saturday.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Jade, group-interaction, t10 @2026-03-23T20:11:00) The group agrees to keep the same group size more or less for the next reunion.
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Lena, group-interaction, t10 @2026-03-23T20:11:00) The group considers making the gallery the anchor for the next reunion, not optional.
[14] (about=Marcus, core, t10 @2026-03-23T20:11:00) Marcus agrees to start a thread in April for the next reunion, preferring a smaller format, curated room, and something cultural before.
[15] (about=Marcus, core, t0 @2026-01-05T19:02:00) initiated the reunion planning early in the new year, aiming for spring (late March or April)
[16] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) At the Saturday meetup, the group discussed the reunion and agreed people want something that feels more like an event this year; Saturday 21st March is the frontrunner for the date.
[17] (about=Sana, core, t10 @2026-03-23T20:11:00) Sana enjoyed the evening, having forgotten what it felt like to just sit and talk without logistics.
[18] (about=Sana, core, t8 @2026-02-02T19:56:00) Sana has blocked the date for the reunion and will confirm properly closer to the time once her rota is out.
[19] (about=GROUP, said_by=Temi, group-interaction, t2 @2026-01-12T18:46:00) The January meetup will double as a soft planning session for the reunion, keeping it casual but discussing format in person
agent_answer:
No — the norm does not apply to everyone. **Jade and Temi** treat it differently (option **A**).

- **Temi** brings a personal career update into the main chat: she announces her article went up, that her editor loved it, and that she is proud of it.
- **Jade** shares personal reflections in the main thread: she talks about how the group became close and about wanting more one-on-one time with Sana and Lena.

The others in the excerpts either stick to reunion/logistics topics or are described as using separate/smaller threads, which matches the norm.

query:
The group seems to operate with an expectation that events should be planned at least three weeks in advance, so that people with families or work shifts can arrange cover. Does this expectation reflect how all members actually behave? If not, who does not follow it and what signals this?

Options:
A. Dev and Omar
B. Callum and Sana
C. Temi and Rachel
D. Jade and Lena
context:
[1] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:31:00) Lena give us a month at least 😄 but yes. smaller format, curated room, something cultural before. I'll start a thread in April. sorted
[2] (about=Callum, episodic, t8 @2026-02-02T20:11:00) gallery is optional Dev, you don't have to justify it. I'll skip the gallery, arrive for dinner. that's just how it works with the kids on a Saturday
[3] (about=Sana, episodic, t18 @2026-12-07T20:55:00) what date is this again, December 19th? Confirming. and for what it's worth I found this year easier with fewer big events. two or three evenings where I could actually be present was better than five I partly missed.
[4] (about=Sana, episodic, t16 @2026-10-19T20:16:00) sorry, hectic week. agree with Jade. I'm glad I came to both events this year. all well.
[5] (about=Jade, episodic, t4 @2026-01-19T20:25:00) Callum I love you but nobody is worried about the nine o'clock cutoff except you 😂 Temi the documentary idea is actually good. what's it about
[6] (about=Callum, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:37:00) also since we're debriefing. I almost didn't come Saturday. things have been difficult at work and I nearly texted Marcus to bail at 5pm. glad I didn't.
[7] (about=Callum, episodic, t14 @2026-09-14T20:35:00) Saturday was the best-attended event in two years and we did an escape room. I'll admit I would not have predicted that. good shout Jade.
[8] (about=Callum, episodic, t6 @2026-01-26T19:40:00) optional works. means those of us with tighter schedules don't feel like we're missing the main event by skipping the first bit
[9] (about=Callum, episodic, t0 @2026-01-05T19:07:00) March works, April gets complicated with school holidays. what venue are we thinking
[10] (about=Rachel, episodic, t4 @2026-01-19T20:31:00) March 21st works. Good venue matters more than format.
[11] (about=Callum, core, t6 @2026-01-26T19:32:00) Callum supports the optional gallery, saying it means those with tighter schedules don't feel like they're missing the main event by skipping the first bit.
[12] (about=Dev, episodic, t10 @2026-03-23T20:32:00) can we do something active before dinner next time. gallery is fine but omar's pitch idea is not the worst thing I've ever heard
[13] (about=Lena, core, t10 @2026-03-23T20:11:00) Lena suggests starting planning for the next one now while they remember what worked.
[14] (about=Marcus, core, t0 @2026-01-05T19:02:00) plans to put out a date poll this week, aiming for last two weekends of March
[15] (about=Marcus, core, t0 @2026-01-05T19:02:00) initiated the reunion planning early in the new year, aiming for spring (late March or April)
[16] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) At the Saturday meetup, the group discussed the reunion and agreed people want something that feels more like an event this year; Saturday 21st March is the frontrunner for the date.
[17] (about=Omar, episodic, t0 @2026-01-05T19:12:00) can we do somthing actually fun this year though? not just siting in a pub for four hours. even if its just a kick around before the food or somthing
[18] (about=Rachel, core, t4 @2026-01-19T20:13:00) Rachel says March 21st works and that good venue matters more than format.
[19] (about=Sana, core, t6 @2026-01-26T19:32:00) Sana asks to confirm the date is March 21st and says she is putting it in her calendar to protect it from on-call.
[20] (about=Temi, core, t12 @2026-04-14T19:45:00) the escape room on Station Road does a group booking for ten, went with a work lot last autumn and it was decent, more like a proper puzzle night than team-building
[21] (about=Temi, core, t12 @2026-04-14T19:45:00) for September, votes for something that gets the group outside if weather cooperates, suggesting open-air cinema or harbour market Saturday evening
agent_answer:
No. **D. Jade and Lena** are the ones who do **not** follow the expectation.

- **Jade** signals this by brushing off Callum’s worry about the 9:00 cutoff: *“nobody is worried about the nine o’clock cutoff except you”* — she isn’t planning around the kind of cover/constraints the advance-notice norm is meant to protect.
- **Lena** signals this because Marcus has to remind her: *“Lena give us a month at least”* — implying she does not reliably give enough advance notice.
